text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for the dorm's 'Health 
Promotion Week.' Patrols will start 
checking to make sure people aren't 
staying up late.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
All tucked in for a cozy good night, huh? 
Don't make me laugh... I take care of my 
own damn self.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I agree... but it seems there will be a 
penalty this time.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Rooms that were deemed "out" have to do a 
whole week of intensive special cleanup 
duty...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"For example, if we get caught during our 
late-night poker match, we'll both go 
'bust' together."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Think I'm gonna tuck my tail and turn into 
a "good girl" over that? ...Hell no, 
Nakayama.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... A poker showdown when the dorm 
head could walk in at any second— No way 
I'd pass up a thrilling match like 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Look at you, you get it. Your brakes are 
busted in the best way possible too.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I was never equipped with such a thing to 
begin with. When it comes to a match, all 
you need is the accelerator...!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"You're the best, Nakayama! Living under 
the same roof as you never gets old!"
